newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jingwei acquisition talks at early stage.
newsitem.headline: Jingwei acquisition talks at early stage.

text.p: Jingwei Textile Machinery Co Ltd said that talks on a possible acquisition of certain companies from its controlling shareholder and independent third parties were still at a preliminary stage.

It said its acquisition criteria were that the target be of a meaningful size and high quality with growth potential, that any acquisitions be in shareholders' and Jingwei's best interests, and that earnings per share would not be diluted.
Jingwei, which is based in northern China's Shanxi province, this week reported net annual profits of 77.81 million yuan for the December year, up from 68.76 million yuan in 1995.
It has an H-share listing in Hong Kong, and a local-currency A-share listing in Shenzhen.
